title: LINE account
intro: Link your LINE account to BCS to get approvals and notifications in LINE, approve smaller amounts from the chat and open BCS pages in the LINE app.

status.reachable: LINE can deliver your tasks and notifications.
status.unreachable: LINE cannot deliver messages to you right now, perhaps because you blocked the organization's LINE account, so e-mail is used instead. Unblock it in the LINE app to get them in LINE again.
status.notLinkedHint: You get your tasks and notifications by e-mail.
status.unavailable: LINE cannot be linked right now: your organization has not finished setting LINE up. Ask your organization administrator if you need it.
status.unavailableLinked: LINE accounts cannot be linked right now: your organization has not finished setting LINE up. Your LINE account stays linked. Ask your organization administrator if you have questions.
status.off: LINE cannot be linked right now: your organization has not switched LINE on. Ask your organization administrator if you need it.
status.offLinked: Your organization has switched LINE off, so your tasks and notifications go by e-mail meanwhile. Your LINE account stays linked, and you get them in LINE again once your organization switches LINE back on. Every task and notification is always in the notification bell on the web.
status.adminLink: Go to the organization's LINE settings

link.title: Link your LINE account
link.intro: Get a link code, then open it in the LINE app on your phone. The code works once and only for a few minutes.
link.howTo: Open this code in the LINE app in one of two ways
link.scan: On a computer or another device, scan this QR code with the camera of a phone that has LINE
link.open: On a phone that has LINE, open this link
link.confirm: In LINE, check that it is your name, then confirm the link
link.qrLabel: QR code to link your LINE account, works once
link.copyFailed: It could not be copied. Select the text and copy it yourself.
link.local: Test mode on this machine (LIFF_MOCK): this link and QR code open the LIFF page of this machine in the browser, not the real LINE app. On that page, open it as a mock LINE user to link.
link.expired: This code has expired. Get a new code to link your account.
link.keepPrivate: Do not send this QR code or link to anyone: whoever opens it first links their LINE to your account. You get an e-mail every time an account is linked.
link.waiting: This page shows the new status by itself once the link is done in LINE.

unlink.title: Unlink
unlink.intro: After unlinking you get your tasks and notifications by e-mail, the approve buttons on LINE cards you already got stop working, and you can link again at any time.
unlink.introUnavailable: After unlinking you get your tasks and notifications by e-mail, the approve buttons on LINE cards you already got stop working, and you can link again only once your organization has LINE fully working.
unlink.confirm: Yes, unlink: the buttons on LINE cards I already got stop working.
unlink.done: Your LINE account was unlinked. Tasks and notifications go by e-mail now.
unlink.doneNotYou: If you did not link that account yourself, set a new password at once on the Forgot password page, which signs you out everywhere.
unlink.notYou: If you did not link this LINE account yourself, unlink it first, then set a new password at once on the Forgot password page, which signs you out everywhere.

errors.CONFIRM: Tick the box to confirm before unlinking.
errors.LINE_NOT_ENABLED: LINE cannot be linked right now: your organization has not switched LINE on or has not finished setting it up. Ask your organization administrator.
errors.ALREADY_LINKED: Your account is linked to LINE already. Unlink it first to link another LINE account.
errors.NOT_LINKED: Your account is not linked to LINE.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again and repeat this.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this. Ask your organization administrator.
errors.BUSY: Something else of yours is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it keeps failing, give this reference to the BCS team.
errors.FAILED: It did not work. Try again.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back, so it is not certain the account was unlinked. Confirm again (it is not done twice) or reload the page to see the status.
